title: Towards Understanding Bias in Synthetic Data for Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using Bland-Altman plots and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to compare the distributions and overall leniency of relevance judgments made by LLMs versus human evaluators.

Employing a Linear Mixed-Effects model and analyzing system rankings to assess whether LLM evaluators systematically assign higher scores to retrieval systems built using similar or identical underlying models (e.g., GPT-4 favoring GPT-based systems).

Using a Linear Mixed-Effects model to examine how specific input characteristics, such as query length and query difficulty, systematically skew the evaluation scores assigned by LLM judges compared to humans.
